name: vscode-llm-bridge
description: Exposes VS Code's Language Model API (GitHub Copilot's signed-in models by default) as a local OpenAI-compatible HTTP/SSE endpoint on port 8766, so ANY external coding agent -- Claude Code, Codex CLI, custom scripts, or any other OpenAI-client-compatible tool -- can use it. Originally built single-purpose for a KiCad dashboard project; generalized for any consumer. Supports real image (vision) input, GET /vendors and /extensions diagnostics, a direct-Anthropic API-key backend (v0.7.0), a claude-cli backend (v0.8.0) that shells out to `claude -p`, riding the user's Claude subscription via CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN instead of metered API billing, and (v0.9.0) a browser-based test UI at GET / -- pick backend/vendor/model, chat, attach images, see streamed responses and per-call cost -- plus a status bar tooltip showing live vendor/model counts and backend configuration state.
